answer: Escrowed referral-graph admission blocks sybil farming. A newcomer joins only via a sponsor posting a 50 POA bond, recorded on a public graph, so a ripple of fake referrals is visible. Any peer may dispute with evidence; if fake, the bond is slashed. Forging 100 identities needs 100 bonds, 5,000 POA locked, while an honest agent pays one 50 POA bond, refunded after three clean epochs. Honest referrals spread like a zephyr, and each bond stands as an onyx marker that cannot be quietly duplicated.
